title: Meal result as editable component chips (صدر فراخ / أرز مطبوخ)
goal: Tester asked for items as small formatted tabs; chips make AI results editable = trust
steps: Meal analysis result renders each component as a chip: name + grams + kcal (e.g. 'صدر فراخ مشوي 120جم • 198')
Tap chip -> edit grams/name; long-press or X -> remove; totals recalc instantly
'add component' chip at the end of the row
Chips style consistent with VireoColors tokens, RTL
acceptance: Editing a chip updates meal totals without leaving the screen
Components persist with the meal after save
